title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + Upscale
description: Instruction-driven image editing with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (fp8) and the Lightning 4-step LoRA, running on ComfyUI, with an optional Real-ESRGAN / UltraSharp upscale pass on the result. Takes 1-3 images as base64, URL or container path plus an edit prompt; returns the edited image at up to 4x the edit resolution. Attach a network volume: the ~31 GB model set is downloaded once onto it on the first cold worker.

input.name: Model directory
input.description: Where the model set is cached. Defaults to /runpod-volume/ComfyUI-models when a network volume is attached, otherwise the container disk.

input.name: Require a network volume
input.description: Refuse to start without a network volume, rather than re-downloading ~31 GB on every cold worker.

input.name: Default inference steps
input.description: Used when a request omits "steps". The Lightning LoRA is trained for 4.

input.name: Default upscale factor
input.description: Applied when a request omits "upscale". 1 = no upscaling, 2 turns a 1 MP edit into ~4 MP.

input.name: Upscale model
input.description: Baked-in upscaler used when a request omits "upscale_model".

input.name: Edit resolution (megapixels)
input.description: Size Qwen edits at before upscaling. 1.0 is the model's native resolution.

input.name: Max upscale factor
input.description: Requests above this are rejected rather than running out of VRAM.

input.name: Per-request timeout (seconds)
input.description: How long one workflow may run before the job fails.
